name: After § 5
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 5b. Is extremely concerned about the influence of non-EU countries and their interference and influence-buying in the European Parliament through a network of non-governmental organisations (NGOs), as revealed in the so-called Qatargate scandal; notes with deep concern the active involvement of the left-wing members of the Subcommittee on Human Rights in the Qatargate scandal;
